title: Listening: Choose a Response I
focus: Reconhecer função comunicativa e resposta natural
verifiableTask: Selecionar respostas adequadas para oito falas curtas

content.text: Ao final da aula você consegue:
reconhecer a função de uma fala e responder de forma natural — na prova e na vida real.
selecionar respostas adequadas para oito falas curtas.
leia as falas marcadas com 🎧 em voz alta, ritmo natural,
Responda rápido e de forma natural (o professor pergunta, o aluno responde sem pensar muito):
Did you have a good weekend?
Do you want to grab a coffee later?
o que você faz quando trava em uma questão?
“Is the library open?” — “Only until six today.”
Do you want to…? / Why don't we…?
“I'd love to.” / “I wish I could, but…”
“I think so too.” / “I'm not so sure.”
“Is the printer working?” — “I just used it.”
“Are you coming to the party?” — “I have an exam the next morning.”
Pronúncia: entonação que mostra a função
Ouça e repita, imitando a melodia:
I'd love to / I'll love to (✘) · I wish I could / I wish I can (✘)
I'd love to, but I have a lab tonight. Maybe next time?

content.text: 🎧 cada fala uma vez. O aluno escolhe em até 10 segundos. Depois,
fala a resposta em voz alta com entonação natural
“Is this seat taken?” — a) Yes, I took it yesterday. b) No, go ahead. c) It's a nice seat.
“Why was the lecture canceled?” — a) On Tuesday. b) The professor is sick. c) Yes, it was.
“Would you like me to proofread your essay?” — a) That would be great, thanks. b) I like essays. c) I read it.
“I can't find my student ID anywhere.” — a) Did you check your backpack? b) My ID is new. c) Yes, you can.
“How long does it take to get downtown by bus?” — a) Every ten minutes. b) About twenty minutes. c) Bus number 5.
“The cafeteria is out of coffee again.” — a) Seriously? That's the second time this week. b) I'd like a coffee, please. c) The cafeteria is big.
“Do you want to join our study group?” — a) Study groups are useful. b) I'd love to. When do you meet? c) I studied in a group.
“I'm thinking about changing my major.” — a) Really? To what? b) Major is important. c) I'm thinking too.
